title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Last Kiss

lines.l: I hold a future that was never built to last
You smile in the mirror like a ghost in the glass
Every mile I drove kept pulling me back to the crash
People say time heals, but they don't know this pain
I trade every sunrise just to see you again
I still hear your voice in the quiet
Like you're whispering my name through the silence
Last, last, last, last
Last kiss still burning on my lips Like a memory I can't eclipse
I reach for you but you're not there Just a shadow out in the midnight air
Last kiss echo in my soul You were the part that made me hold in love
Turn back destiny, you'll still be right here
Next to me
Walking through the places where we carved our dreams
Your laughter in the wind hits harder than it seems
Every picture on my phone feels like a promise I broke
Every word unspoken, now I'm stuck in my throat
Talking to the stars, hoping one of them is you
Sending little messages through the dark and the blue
Life keeps moving like a train I never meant to miss
But I'm frozen in the moment of our final fading kiss
If I could turn the wheel back
Rewrite the night and change the track
I'd hold you closer than before
Never let you slip out the door
Last kiss is burning on my lips
Like a fire, can't dismiss
I close my eyes and you appear
But you fade away when I get near
Last kiss, back up in my chest
You were the one who knew me best
If love could spend reality
You'd still be right here
Next to me
The events music. Time.
Sono le 7 di un minuto.
